outcome.description: issues-found when at least one issue is reported.

overview.description: Two or three sentences on what the change does and how sound it is.

issues.description: Real defects only, most severe first. Empty when outcome is no-issues.

severity.description: blocker: must not ship; major: likely bug or risk; minor: worth fixing, low impact.

line.description: First line the issue refers to.

end_line.description: Last line, when the issue spans several lines.

problem.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: The input, state, or code path that makes it fail.

fix.description: The smallest change that resolves it.

unchecked.description: Things the reviewer could not verify, such as missing context or behavior that needs a run.
